description: This file defines a client-side storage class 'Store' for managing 'todo' items, including methods for CRUD operations and storage management, and exports it to the global window object.

classes.name: Store
classes.description: A constructor function for managing a collection of todo items in client-side storage, with methods for finding, saving, removing, and dropping data.

methods.name: Store
methods.description: Constructor function initializing a storage instance with a specified name and callback.

methods.name: find
methods.description: Finds todo items matching a query object.

methods.name: findAll
methods.description: Retrieves all todo items from storage.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves or updates a todo item in storage, generating a new ID if necessary.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes a todo item by ID from storage.

methods.name: drop
methods.description: Clears all todo items from storage.
